messages:
Priya Rao: AM check-in — quick status: shipped routing-throttle spec yesterday. Blocker: need final perf numbers for quantized model before we lock rollout.
Marco Chen: on it. running perf sweep now (20qps/50qps). ETA ~1-2h. saw a couple CI flakes on model-x, filing an issue.
Ben Park: noted. re: canary infra, I can stand up the canary cluster once perf numbers look stable. what QPS are we targeting?
Priya Rao: target ~20 qps for initial canary, p95 <120ms. fallback plan: smaller shard if latency >120ms. also pinging @Alice for rollback checklist and CR approvals. PRs to watch: #4123 (routing flags), #4127 (docs + telemetry).
Alice Nguyen: skimmed #4123 — one minor env var nit (REDWOOD_BATCH vs REDWOOD_BATCHING). #4127 looks fine. will approve after tests pass.
Marco Chen: perf results: quantized p95=110ms @20qps on g5. 50qps pushes p95 to ~180ms. logged issue #998 for KV-cache misses causing 10% latency spikes. uploading logs: https://redwood.internal/links/logs/998
Ben Park: thanks. I'll schedule canary rollout at 14:30 PT and attach deploy plan. who owns rollback steps? @Alice?
Alice Nguyen: happy to own rollback checklist. will post checklist + playbook in this thread before deploy.
Priya Rao: awesome. blockers cleared for now. Ben — please add the canary dashboard widget for route/latency/cost. also remind docs folks to add the new config name.
Ben Park: will do. quick note for infra: use `REDWOOD_BATCH=dynamic` in canary env, not the legacy flag.
deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: canary start=2026-03-17T21:30:00Z initiated_by=Ben Park status=pending_approvals
Ben Park: approvals done, go ahead when checklist is up.
Priya Rao: thanks team — will follow up after canary smoke. :thumbsup:
